Use one Vercel-hosted Next app, Neon with an interactive PostgreSQL driver and existing app-owned Better Auth; prove scoped read-lock-write/rollback and least-privilege runtime separately from operator migration connection. No second auth service or standalone worker is selected.

Resolve server-owned keys/versions and retain current owner/tenant/MIME/size/replacement/delete/history rules, ordinary orphan recovery and exact-reviewed Evry mutations; no new generic file framework/table.

Direct delivery is supported; already-issued bearer URLs may survive later grant revocation until expiry. Prove expiry/cache/deletion behavior; no false instantaneous recall promise or forced byte proxy.

Selected Vercel Next/Neon/app-owned Better Auth/private Tigris/Resend settings, synthetic preview isolation, DB plus byte restore and current file/tenant authority must be proven. Seven-day recovery/daily snapshots/separate private Tigris backup and ordinary measured 1h/4h are selected target; actual paid plan/spend/configuration/credentials/restore remains unauthorized by documentation.

Use the exact verified available global 96 article/21 section/7 system-message-template bundle as future starter content; preserve IDs/slugs/topology/hashes and authoritative SME Playbook/rubric. Editorial contradictions remain named SME work. Seven message templates are not the 11 generated-document templates; no tenant/customer rows or live export/bootstrap execution.

One currently authorized published global/church/network version of the same canonical article supplies credit; no every-version requirement or draft credit. Preserve exact read source/revision/account evidence, six Discovery identities and strict>80% per eligible lead/Owner; never match unrelated same-title articles or combine different people to manufacture completion.

Retained reading completion does not authorize hidden/unpublished/departed source bodies or a retained copy. Current source grants still apply; keep already-approved source priority and body-revocation rules, with no new authoring/permission/threshold or automatic reading/Discovery/training reset.
